title: The Sure sign of the rain
subtitle: 决策选择 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）
meta: 主题语境：决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）　|　核心词汇：sure　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 sure 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1985 the builder wrote of ① a sure sign of the rain in the plan, and everybody in the site said at once that it was ② surer than the one named there the year before. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the builder, who never explained anything, had done it for the whole place and gone home; it was the sure ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the surest sign of the rain anybody in the site had ever seen, or so the plan for October 1979 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too sure to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the assistant who had come to help; the sure ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a sure hand at the wheel, and said that no assistant in his right mind would call it ⑥ as sure as the hand at the wheel they had once had in the old site. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was sure or not, and he said so.

By 1992 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the plan. What the line asked for was ⑦ something sure, and nothing besides. The assistant from the next site called the whole plan ⑧ quite sure; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the plan kept the names of the sure ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1995, without a word of thanks, she wrote of another sure sign of the rain in the same plan, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ surer than anybody had expected. ⑩ The surest hand at the wheel in the whole site, she said in 1997, was the one she could never quite name; the sure ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 确定（前置定语 a sure sign of the rain：1985 年施工员在施工图里记下的那件确定的确切迹象）
B. adj. 确定／稳当（比较级 surer than：文中两处，一处比下雨的确切迹象，一处比预想）
C. adj. 确定／稳当（最高级 the surest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 确定（表语 too sure to do：母亲觉得它太确定，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 稳当（前置定语 a sure hand at the wheel：叔叔把整件事称作一桩稳当的手）
F. adj. 稳当（同级比较 as sure as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩掌舵稳当的手相比）
G. adj. 稳当（后置定语 something sure：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 稳当（受程度副词修饰 quite sure：那位帮工的评价）

items.q: a sure sign of the rain
the surest sign of the rain anybody
a sure hand at the wheel
The surest hand at the wheel in

answers.why: sure 意为“确定”，1985 年施工员在施工图里记下的是“一件确定的确切迹象”，此处作前置定语 a sure sign of the rain。
sure 意为“确定”，此处用比较级 surer than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
sure 意为“确定”，施工图上 十月 那行字说它是工地里最确定的一件，故用最高级 the surest sign of the rain。
sure 意为“确定”，母亲认为这件东西“太确定了，谁也用不上”，too sure to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
sure 意为“稳当”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩稳当的手”，此处作前置定语 a sure hand at the wheel。
sure 意为“稳当”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩掌舵稳当的手一样稳当”，同级比较用 as sure as。
sure 意为“稳当”，施工图上那半行字要的是“稳当的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something sure。
sure 意为“稳当”，邻工地来的那位帮工认为这套计划“相当稳当”，quite 修饰原级 sure。
sure 意为“稳当”，1995 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要稳当”，故用比较级 surer than。
sure 意为“稳当”，母亲 1997 年说的是“整个工地里最稳当的那一桩”，故用最高级 the surest hand at the wheel。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1985 年，施工员在施工图里记下了一件确定的确切迹象。（a sure sign of the rain）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更确定。（surer than …）
母亲觉得它太确定，谁也用不上。（too sure to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩稳当的手。（a sure hand at the wheel）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩掌舵稳当的手一样稳当。（as sure as …）
到了 1992 年，施工图上只剩半行字：要的是一件稳当的东西。（something sure）
answers: In 1985 the builder wrote of a sure sign of the rain in the plan.
Everybody said it was surer than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too sure to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a sure hand at the wheel.
He said nobody would call it as sure as the hand at the wheel they had once had.
By 1992 the plan asked for nothing but something sure.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 sure 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1985 the builder wrote of a sure sign of the rain in the plan, and nobody forgot it.
It was the surest sign of the rain in the site, or so the plan says.
My mother thought it too sure to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a sure hand at the wheel, and nobody argued with him.
The assistant from the next site called the plan quite sure, and everybody laughed.
The sure ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
